_meta.source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2025
_meta.note_coordinates: lat/lng values are US Census Bureau geographic centroids (display-only). They are NOT part of BLS data.
_meta.note_employment: employment values are BLS OEWS employment (datatype 01, cross-industry). lq values are BLS OEWS location quotient (datatype 17).
_meta.note_soc_codes: SOC codes match MAP_TITLE_TO_SOC in src/utils/onet.ts exactly. Some titles share a SOC (e.g. Marketing Manager and Brand Manager both map to 11-2021). The map aggregation layer de-dupes by SOC.
